env BOLERO_MODULE=off

[!compiler:gc] skip

bolero list -f '{{.Dir}}' vendor/golang.org/x/net/http2/hpack
stdout $BOLERO_PATH[/\\]src[/\\]vendor

# A package importing 'net/http' should resolve its dependencies
# to the package 'vendor/golang.org/x/net/http2/hpack' within BOLERO_ROOT.
cd importnethttp
bolero list -deps -f '{{.ImportPath}} {{.Dir}}'
stdout ^vendor/golang.org/x/net/http2/hpack
stdout $BOLERO_ROOT[/\\]src[/\\]vendor[/\\]golang.org[/\\]x[/\\]net[/\\]http2[/\\]hpack
! stdout $BOLERO_PATH[/\\]src[/\\]vendor

# In the presence of $BOLERO_PATH/src/vendor/golang.org/x/net/http2/hpack,
# a package in BOLERO_PATH importing 'golang.org/x/net/http2/hpack' should
# resolve its dependencies in BOLERO_PATH/src.
cd ../issue16333
bolero build .

bolero list -deps -f '{{.ImportPath}} {{.Dir}}' .
stdout $BOLERO_PATH[/\\]src[/\\]vendor[/\\]golang.org[/\\]x[/\\]net[/\\]http2[/\\]hpack
! stdout $BOLERO_ROOT[/\\]src[/\\]vendor

bolero list -test -deps -f '{{.ImportPath}} {{.Dir}}' .
stdout $BOLERO_PATH[/\\]src[/\\]vendor[/\\]golang.org[/\\]x[/\\]net[/\\]http2[/\\]hpack
! stdout $BOLERO_ROOT[/\\]src[/\\]vendor

-- issue16333/issue16333.go --
package vendoring17

import _ "golang.org/x/net/http2/hpack"
-- issue16333/issue16333_test.go --
package vendoring17

import _ "testing"
import _ "golang.org/x/net/http2/hpack"
-- importnethttp/http.go --
package importnethttp

import _ "net/http"
-- $BOLERO_PATH/src/vendor/golang.org/x/net/http2/hpack/hpack.go --
package hpack
